children.text: When preparing a dataset, source-group assignment prevents related examples from crossing train, validation, and test boundaries. Published metadata records actual split counts, source references, and manifest digests.

Cancellation sets the job desired action to cancel. The running worker receives the request, stops execution, records terminal evidence, and releases its allocated slots. A request acknowledgement is distinct from terminal completion.

Model qualification uses held-out evaluation metrics, sample counts, and uncertainty intervals. Review quality across slices before promoting a candidate. Training loss alone is not a release criterion.
Full source text and exact metadata.
